params._comment: Orbital template for stage-growth unlocks, CUT-EXPANSION reshoot: rotating HERO shot. Low dramatic pickup at the edge, rising lookAt-tracked orbit, then the god-ray backlight moment at t~0.58 — the camera dips low and tight (fov 54, lookAt raised to y 8 so the ring edge stands against the sky) while a warm-lilac bloom fade + beam-hum sell the backlight blowout (the sun position is not authorable from a path, so the ray read is carried by bloom + silhouette framing; ExpansionSequence's fallback play adds a one-shot cutscene_veil flare at the anchor on the same beat). High reveal finish over the new ring. The play payload supplies the anchor position (nearest old ring edge); keyframe positions are offsets from that anchor. Also the FLYOVER fallback when expansion_flyover is missing/disabled.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
